extracted text: The paper discusses A356 aluminum alloy which is widely used to produce automobile wheels and other parts due to its good casting properties, mechanical properties, corrosion resistance, and physical properties. The high strength of the A356 alloy is mainly derived from the precipitation hardening of fine Mg2Si phases. The paper investigates the effects of friction stir processing (FSP) parameters on the microstructure and tensile properties of this alloy. The T6 heat treatment mentioned involves solution treatment at 540°C for 4 hours followed by artificial aging at 165°C for 5 hours.
